  # ============================================================
  migrate:
    name: Run Database Migrations
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [build, tag]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop' || github.event_name == 'release'
    # Staging (main branch) can continue on transient migration connectivity issues.
    # Develop and production must fail fast on migration errors.
    continue-on-error: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'release' }}
    # Routes to dev KV on develop push, staging KV on main push, production KV on release
    environment: ${{ github.event_name == 'release' && 'production' || (github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop' && 'development' || 'staging') }}
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pip'
          cache-dependency-path: backend/requirements.txt

      - name: Install migration dependencies
        run: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt

      - name: Azure Login (OIDC)
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Get database URL from Key Vault
        id: secrets
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "release" ]]; then
            KV_NAME="nuguard-prod-kv"
          elif [[ "${{ github.ref }}" == "refs/heads/develop" ]]; then
            KV_NAME="nuguard-dev-kv"
          else
            KV_NAME="nuguard-stage-kv"
          fi

          echo "Using Key Vault: $KV_NAME"
          az account show --query '{tenantId:tenantId, subscriptionId:id, environmentName:environmentName}' -o jsonc || true

          DATABASE_URL=""
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            echo "Fetching DATABASE-URL from Key Vault (attempt $attempt/3)..."
            if DATABASE_URL=$(az keyvault secret show \
              --vault-name "$KV_NAME" \
              --name DATABASE-URL \
              --query value -o tsv 2>/tmp/kv_error.log); then
              if [[ -n "$DATABASE_URL" ]]; then
                break
              fi
              echo "Retrieved an empty DATABASE-URL value from Key Vault."
            else
              cat /tmp/kv_error.log
            fi

            if [[ $attempt -lt 3 ]]; then
              echo "Retrying in 10 seconds..."
              sleep 10
            else
              echo "Failed to fetch DATABASE-URL from Key Vault after 3 attempts."
              exit 1
            fi
          done

          echo "::add-mask::$DATABASE_URL"
          echo "database_url=$DATABASE_URL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run migrations
        run: |
          cd backend
          # Retry loop: newly deployed services can exhaust DB connections temporarily.
          # Also handles consolidated baseline: old revision IDs (e.g. 003_merge_controls)
          # that were squashed into 001_initial_schema are stamped before retrying.
          run_migrations() {
            local output
            if output=$(alembic upgrade heads 2>&1); then
              echo "$output"
              return 0
            fi
            local err=$?
            echo "$output"
            echo "Upgrade failed (exit $err) - checking cause..."
            if echo "$output" | grep -q "Can't locate revision"; then
              echo "Stale revision detected - stamping consolidated baseline..."
              alembic stamp --purge 001_initial_schema
            elif echo "$output" | grep -qi "deadlock detected\|DeadlockDetectedError"; then
              echo "Deadlock detected - waiting 15s before retry..."
              sleep 15
              return 1
            fi
            alembic upgrade heads
          }
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            echo "Migration attempt $attempt..."
            run_migrations && break
            [ $attempt -lt 3 ] && echo "Retrying in 20s..." && sleep 20
          done
          echo "Verifying DB is at expected head..."
          CURRENT=$(alembic current 2>&1)
          echo "$CURRENT"
          if echo "$CURRENT" | grep -q "(head)"; then
            echo "✅ Database is at migration head"
          else
            echo "WARNING: Database may not be fully migrated — 'alembic current' did not report (head)"
          fi
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ steps.secrets.outputs.database_url }}

# NuGuard AI - E2E Testing Pipeline
# Runs Playwright tests against staging environment
# Used as release gate for production deployments

name: E2E Tests

on:
  # Run on staging deployments
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Frontend CI/CD", "Backend CI/CD"]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  
  # Manual trigger for testing
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Environment to test'
        required: true
        default: 'staging'
        type: choice
        options:
          - staging
          - production
      
  # Run nightly on staging
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # 2 AM UTC daily

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '22'

jobs:
  # ============================================================
  # E2E Tests
  # ============================================================
  e2e-tests:
    name: E2E Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_run' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium firefox
        working-directory: frontend

      - name: Determine test environment
        id: env
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}" == "production" ]]; then
            echo "base_url=https://app.nuguard.ai" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "api_url=https://api.nuguard.ai" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "base_url=https://staging.nuguard.ai" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "api_url=https://api-staging.nuguard.ai" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Wait for deployment to be ready
        run: |
          echo "Checking API health..."
          for i in {1..30}; do
            if curl -sf "${{ steps.env.outputs.api_url }}/health"; then
              echo "API is ready!"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for API... ($i/30)"
            sleep 10
          done

      - name: Run Playwright tests
        run: npx playwright test
        working-directory: frontend
        env:
          TEST_BASE_URL: ${{ steps.env.outputs.base_url }}
          TEST_API_URL: ${{ steps.env.outputs.api_url }}
          # Test credentials from secrets
          TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL }}
          TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: playwright-report
          path: frontend/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Upload test videos
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: test-videos
          path: frontend/test-results/
          retention-days: 7

  # ============================================================
  # API Integration Tests
  # ============================================================
  api-tests:
    name: API Integration Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install test dependencies
        run: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt pytest-asyncio

      - name: Determine test environment
        id: env
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}" == "production" ]]; then
            echo "api_url=https://api.nuguard.ai" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "api_url=https://api-staging.nuguard.ai" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Run API tests
        run: |
          cd backend && pytest tests/ -m integration -v --tb=short \
            --ignore=tests/test_stage1_integration.py \
            -p no:cacheprovider
        env:
          TEST_API_URL: ${{ steps.env.outputs.api_url }}
          TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL }}
          TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD }}

  # ============================================================
  # Performance Baseline Tests
  # ============================================================
  performance-tests:
    name: Performance Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}

      - name: Install k6
        run: |
          sudo gpg -k
          sudo gpg --no-default-keyring --keyring /usr/share/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg --keyserver hkp://keyserver.ubuntu.com:80 --recv-keys C5AD17C747E3415A3642D57D77C6C491D6AC1D69
          echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/k6-archive-keyring.gpg] https://dl.k6.io/deb stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/k6.list
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install k6

      - name: Determine test environment
        id: env
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}" == "production" ]]; then
            echo "api_url=https://api.nuguard.ai" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "api_url=https://api-staging.nuguard.ai" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Run performance baseline tests
        run: |
          k6 run tests/performance/baseline.js \
            --env API_URL=${{ steps.env.outputs.api_url }} \
            --out json=results.json
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Upload performance results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: performance-results
          path: results.json
          retention-days: 30

  # ============================================================
  # Release Gate Check
  # ============================================================
  release-gate:
    name: Release Gate Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [e2e-tests, api-tests, performance-tests]
    if: always()
    
    steps:
      - name: Check test results
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ needs.e2e-tests.result }}" != "success" ]]; then
            echo "❌ E2E tests failed - release gate blocked"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if [[ "${{ needs.api-tests.result }}" != "success" ]]; then
            echo "❌ API tests failed - release gate blocked"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Performance tests are advisory, not blocking
          if [[ "${{ needs.performance-tests.result }}" != "success" ]]; then
            echo "⚠️ Performance tests failed - review required but not blocking"
          fi
          
          echo "✅ All release gates passed!"

      - name: Create release gate status
        run: |
          echo "Release Gate Summary:"
          echo "- E2E Tests: ${{ needs.e2e-tests.result }}"
          echo "- API Tests: ${{ needs.api-tests.result }}"
          echo "- Performance Tests: ${{ needs.performance-tests.result }}"

# NuGuard AI - Frontend CI/CD Pipeline
# Deploys React SPA to Azure Static Web Apps
# 
# Environments:
#   - develop branch → Dev (dev.nuguard.ai)
#   - main branch → Staging (staging.nuguard.ai)
#   - release/* tags → Production (app.nuguard.ai)

name: Frontend CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'frontend/**'
      - '.github/workflows/frontend.yml'
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'frontend/**'
      - '.github/workflows/frontend.yml'
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '22'

jobs:
  # ============================================================
  # Lint & Type Check
  # ============================================================
  lint:
    name: Lint & Type Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !(github.head_ref == 'develop' && github.base_ref == 'main')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: frontend

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npm run lint
        working-directory: frontend

      - name: TypeScript type check
        run: npx tsc --noEmit
        working-directory: frontend

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: npm run test:coverage
        working-directory: frontend

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        with:
          files: ./frontend/coverage/coverage-final.json
          flags: frontend
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

  # ============================================================
  # Build
  # ============================================================
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: frontend

      - name: Determine environment and API gateway URL
        id: env-config
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "release" ]]; then
            echo "gateway=https://api.nuguard.ai" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "environment=production" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [[ "${{ github.ref }}" == "refs/heads/main" ]]; then
            echo "gateway=https://api-staging.nuguard.ai" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "environment=staging" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "gateway=https://api-dev.nuguard.ai" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "environment=development" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Build application
        run: npm run build
        working-directory: frontend
        env:
          VITE_USE_MOCK_MODE: 'false'
          VITE_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ steps.env-config.outputs.environment }}
          VITE_DATA_SERVICE_URL: ${{ steps.env-config.outputs.gateway }}/api/data
          VITE_ASSETS_SERVICE_URL: ${{ steps.env-config.outputs.gateway }}/api/assets
          VITE_COMPLIANCE_SERVICE_URL: ${{ steps.env-config.outputs.gateway }}/api/compliance
          VITE_REDTEAM_SERVICE_URL: ${{ steps.env-config.outputs.gateway }}/api/redteam
          VITE_CHAT_SERVICE_URL: ${{ steps.env-config.outputs.gateway }}/api/chat
          VITE_BEHAVIOR_SERVICE_URL: ${{ steps.env-config.outputs.gateway }}/api/behavior
          VITE_ENABLE_SBOM_GRAPH: ${{ steps.env-config.outputs.environment == 'development' && 'true' || 'false' }}
          VITE_ENABLE_DEMO_CREDENTIALS: ${{ steps.env-config.outputs.environment != 'development' && 'false' || 'true' }}

      - name: Verify developer guides are not in deploy artifact
        run: npm run check:frontend-artifacts

      - name: Upload build artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: frontend-dist
          path: frontend/dist
          retention-days: 7

  # ============================================================
  # Deploy to Development (develop branch)
  # ============================================================
  deploy-dev:
    name: Deploy to Development
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop' && github.event_name == 'push'
    environment:
      name: development
      url: https://dev.nuguard.ai
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download build artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: frontend-dist
          path: frontend/dist

      - name: Deploy to Azure Static Web Apps (Dev)
        uses: Azure/static-web-apps-deploy@v1
        with:
          azure_static_web_apps_api_token: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SWA_TOKEN_DEV }}
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          action: 'upload'
          app_location: 'frontend/dist'
          output_location: ''
          skip_api_build: true
          skip_app_build: true

      - name: Notify deployment
        run: |
          echo "✅ Deployed to Development: https://dev.nuguard.ai"

  # ============================================================
  # Deploy to Staging (main branch)
  # ============================================================
  deploy-staging:
    name: Deploy to Staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'
    environment:
      name: staging
      url: https://staging.nuguard.ai
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download build artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: frontend-dist
          path: frontend/dist

      - name: Deploy to Azure Static Web Apps (Staging)
        uses: Azure/static-web-apps-deploy@v1
        with:
          azure_static_web_apps_api_token: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SWA_TOKEN_STAGING }}
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          action: 'upload'
          app_location: 'frontend/dist'
          output_location: ''
          skip_api_build: true
          skip_app_build: true

      - name: Notify deployment
        run: |
          echo "✅ Deployed to Staging: https://staging.nuguard.ai"
          echo "✅ Demo environment: https://demo.nuguard.ai"

  # ============================================================
  # Deploy to Production (release tags)
  # ============================================================
  deploy-prod:
    name: Deploy to Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    if: github.event_name == 'release'
    environment:
      name: production
      url: https://app.nuguard.ai
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download build artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: frontend-dist
          path: frontend/dist

      - name: Deploy to Azure Static Web Apps (Production)
        uses: Azure/static-web-apps-deploy@v1
        with:
          azure_static_web_apps_api_token: ${{ secrets.AZURE_SWA_TOKEN_PROD }}
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          action: 'upload'
          app_location: 'frontend/dist'
          output_location: ''
          skip_api_build: true
          skip_app_build: true

      - name: Notify deployment
        run: |
          echo "🚀 Deployed to Production: https://app.nuguard.ai"
          echo "Release: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"

# NuGuard — One-time APIM provisioning workflow
#
# Run this ONCE per environment when first setting up APIM, or to update
# global policies (CORS origins, rate limits). NOT needed for regular deploys;
# backend.yml updates backend service URLs automatically on each push.
#
# After provisioning, update the DNS CNAME records:
#   dev:     api-dev.nuguard.ai     → <apimGatewayUrl from output>
#   staging: api-staging.nuguard.ai → <apimGatewayUrl from output>
#   prod:    api.nuguard.ai         → <apimGatewayUrl from output>

name: Provision APIM

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Target environment'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, staging, prod]
      publisher_email:
        description: 'APIM publisher email'
        required: false
        default: 'api@nuguard.ai'

jobs:
  provision:
    name: Provision APIM (${{ inputs.environment }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ inputs.environment == 'prod' && 'production' || (inputs.environment == 'staging' && 'staging' || 'development') }}
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Azure Login (OIDC)
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ vars.AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Set environment variables
        id: env
        run: |
          case "${{ inputs.environment }}" in
            dev)
              echo "rg=Dev" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "origins=[\"https://dev.nuguard.ai\",\"http://localhost:3000\",\"http://localhost:5173\"]" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              ;;
            staging)
              echo "rg=Stage" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "origins=[\"https://staging.nuguard.ai\",\"https://demo.nuguard.ai\",\"http://localhost:3000\"]" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              ;;
            prod)
              echo "rg=Prod" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "origins=[\"https://app.nuguard.ai\"]" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Deploy APIM via Bicep
        id: deploy
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          DEPLOY_OUTPUT=$(az deployment group create \
            --resource-group "${{ steps.env.outputs.rg }}" \
            --template-file infra/apim.bicep \
            --parameters \
              environment="${{ inputs.environment }}" \
              publisherEmail="${{ inputs.publisher_email }}" \
              allowedOrigins='${{ steps.env.outputs.origins }}' \
            --output json)

          echo "$DEPLOY_OUTPUT" > /tmp/apim-deploy.json

          GATEWAY_URL=$(echo "$DEPLOY_OUTPUT" | \

# NuGuard AI - Schema Synchronization Validation
# Ensures API schemas, database models, and frontend types stay in sync
#
# Runs on:
#   - PRs touching backend/shared/schemas.py, models.py, or frontend/src/schemas.ts
#   - Daily scheduled check to catch drift
#
# Tests:
#   1. Backend schema sync tests (Pydantic ↔ SQLAlchemy)
#   2. OpenAPI spec generation
#   3. Frontend type validation (optional, when generation is set up)

name: Schema Validation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'backend/shared/schemas.py'
      - 'backend/shared/models/**'
      - 'frontend/src/schemas.ts'
      - 'frontend/src/schemas/**'
      - '.github/workflows/schema-validation.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths:
      - 'backend/shared/schemas.py'
      - 'backend/shared/models/**'
      - 'frontend/src/schemas.ts'
      - 'frontend/src/schemas/**'
  schedule:
    # Run daily at 6am UTC to catch any schema drift
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:  # Allow manual trigger

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: '3.12'
  NODE_VERSION: '22'

jobs:
  # ============================================================
  # Backend Schema Sync Tests
  # ============================================================
  backend-schema-sync:
    name: Backend Schema Sync
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || !(github.head_ref == 'develop' && github.base_ref == 'main')
    
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
          POSTGRES_DB: nuguard_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pip'
          cache-dependency-path: backend/requirements.txt

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
          pip install pytest pytest-asyncio

      - name: Run schema sync tests
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://test:test@localhost:5432/nuguard_test
        run: |
          cd backend
          python -m pytest tests/test_schema_sync.py -v --tb=short
        continue-on-error: false  # Fail build if schema sync tests fail

  # ============================================================
  # OpenAPI Spec Generation Check
  # ============================================================
  openapi-check:
    name: OpenAPI Spec Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: backend-schema-sync
    
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test
          POSTGRES_DB: nuguard_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pip'
          cache-dependency-path: backend/requirements.txt

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://test:test@localhost:5432/nuguard_test
          GEMINI_API_KEY: dummy-for-startup
        run: |
          cd backend/data_service
          python -c "
          import json
          from main import app
          spec = app.openapi()
          with open('../../docs/openapi.generated.json', 'w') as f:
              json.dump(spec, f, indent=2)
          print('OpenAPI spec generated successfully')
          print(f'Endpoints: {len(spec.get(\"paths\", {}))}')
          print(f'Schemas: {len(spec.get(\"components\", {}).get(\"schemas\", {}))}')
          "

      - name: Validate OpenAPI spec structure
        run: |
          cd docs
          python -c "
          import json
          with open('openapi.generated.json') as f:
              spec = json.load(f)
          
          # Check critical schemas exist
          schemas = spec.get('components', {}).get('schemas', {})
          
          required_schemas = [
              'FindingResponse',
              'CoveredControlResponse', 
              'ScanResponse',
              # ApplicationResponse is served by ai_asset_service (/api/assets/)
              # not data_service, so it is intentionally absent from this spec.
          ]
          
          missing = [s for s in required_schemas if s not in schemas]
          if missing:
              raise ValueError(f'Missing required schemas: {missing}')
          
          # Validate FindingResponse has policy_name
          finding_schema = schemas.get('FindingResponse', {})
          finding_props = finding_schema.get('properties', {})
          if 'policy_name' not in finding_props:
              raise ValueError('FindingResponse is missing policy_name field!')
          
          print('✓ All required schemas present')
          print('✓ FindingResponse has policy_name field')
          print('OpenAPI spec validation passed')
          "

      - name: Upload OpenAPI spec artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: openapi-spec
          path: docs/openapi.generated.json
          retention-days: 7

  # ============================================================
  # Frontend Schema Validation (Optional - when types are generated)
  # ============================================================
  frontend-schema-check:
    name: Frontend Schema Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: openapi-check
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule'  # Skip on daily cron
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json

      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm ci

      - name: Download OpenAPI spec
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: openapi-spec
          path: docs/

      - name: Generate TypeScript types from OpenAPI
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npx openapi-typescript ../docs/openapi.generated.json -o src/schemas.generated.ts
        continue-on-error: true  # Don't fail yet - types may need manual review

      - name: Check for schema drift
        run: |
          cd frontend/src
          if [ -f schemas.generated.ts ]; then
            echo "✓ Generated types from OpenAPI spec"
            echo "Generated file size: $(wc -l < schemas.generated.ts) lines"
            
            # Check if critical types exist
            if grep -q "FindingResponse" schemas.generated.ts; then
              echo "✓ FindingResponse type generated"
            fi
            
            if grep -q "policy_name" schemas.generated.ts; then
              echo "✓ policy_name field present in generated types"
            else
              echo "⚠ Warning: policy_name may be missing from generated types"
            fi
          else
            echo "⚠ schemas.generated.ts not created - check openapi-typescript output"
          fi

  # ============================================================
  # Notify on Schema Drift
  # ============================================================
  notify-drift:
    name: Notify on Drift
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [backend-schema-sync, openapi-check]
    if: failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    
    steps:
      - name: Create issue for schema drift
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const title = '⚠️ Schema Drift Detected';
            const body = `
            ## Schema Synchronization Check Failed
            
            The daily schema validation check has detected potential schema drift between:
            - Backend Pydantic schemas (\`backend/shared/schemas.py\`)
            - SQLAlchemy models (\`backend/shared/models.py\`)
            - Frontend Zod schemas (\`frontend/src/schemas.ts\`)
            
            ### Action Required
            1. Check the [workflow run](${context.serverUrl}/${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}/actions/runs/${context.runId})
            2. Review the failing tests to identify mismatched fields
            3. Update schemas to ensure consistency across all layers
            
            ### Common Fixes
            - Add missing fields to Pydantic response schemas
            - Update serializers to include new model fields
            - Regenerate frontend types from OpenAPI spec
            
            /cc @${context.actor}
            `;
            
            // Check if similar issue already exists
            const issues = await github.rest.issues.listForRepo({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open',
              labels: 'schema-drift'
            });
            
            if (issues.data.length === 0) {
              await github.rest.issues.create({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                title: title,
                body: body,
                labels: ['schema-drift', 'bug', 'automated']
              });
            }

extras.workflow_content:
# NuGuard AI - Environment Smoke Tests
#
# Verifies that a deployed environment is correctly wired end-to-end:
#   1. Gateway /health responds 200
#   2. CORS headers allow the SWA frontend origin
#   3. Frontend SWA returns 200 (app is reachable)
#   4. Auth endpoint rejects unauthenticated requests (403/401 — not 502/404)
#   5. Key API routes are routed correctly through the gateway
#
# Trigger manually from the Actions tab, or automatically on pushes to
# develop/main (using each branch's latest workflow file).

name: Smoke Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]

  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Environment to test'
        required: true
        default: 'staging'
        type: choice
        options:
          - dev
          - staging
          - prod

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # ============================================================
  # Resolve environment URLs from trigger context
  # ============================================================
  resolve-env:
    name: Resolve Environment
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      api_url: ${{ steps.urls.outputs.api_url }}
      frontend_url: ${{ steps.urls.outputs.frontend_url }}
      env_name: ${{ steps.urls.outputs.env_name }}
    steps:
      - name: Determine target environment
        id: urls
        run: |
          # workflow_dispatch: use the explicit input
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "workflow_dispatch" ]]; then
            ENV="${{ github.event.inputs.environment }}"
          # push on develop -> dev; push on main -> staging
          elif [[ "${{ github.ref_name }}" == "develop" ]]; then
            ENV="dev"
          elif [[ "${{ github.ref_name }}" == "main" ]]; then
            ENV="staging"
          else
            echo "Unsupported branch/event combination: event=${{ github.event_name }}, ref=${{ github.ref_name }}"
            exit 1
          fi

          case "$ENV" in
            dev)
              echo "api_url=https://api-dev.nuguard.ai"       >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "frontend_url=https://dev.nuguard.ai"      >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "env_name=development"                      >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              ;;
            staging)
              echo "api_url=https://api-staging.nuguard.ai"   >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "frontend_url=https://staging.nuguard.ai"  >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "env_name=staging"                         >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              ;;
            prod)
              echo "api_url=https://api.nuguard.ai"           >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "frontend_url=https://app.nuguard.ai"      >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              echo "env_name=production"                      >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              ;;
          esac

  # ============================================================
  # Smoke Tests
  # ============================================================
  smoke:
    name: Smoke Tests (${{ needs.resolve-env.outputs.env_name }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: resolve-env

    env:
      API_URL: ${{ needs.resolve-env.outputs.api_url }}
      FRONTEND_URL: ${{ needs.resolve-env.outputs.frontend_url }}
      ENV_NAME: ${{ needs.resolve-env.outputs.env_name }}

    steps:
      - name: Wait for services to stabilise
        # Give ACA replicas time to become ready after a fresh deploy
        run: sleep 20

      - name: Workflow diagnostics
        run: |
          echo "Workflow ref: ${{ github.ref }}"
          echo "Workflow SHA: ${{ github.sha }}"
          echo "Event: ${{ github.event_name }}"
          echo "Ref name: ${{ github.ref_name }}"
          echo "API URL: $API_URL"
          echo "Frontend URL: $FRONTEND_URL"
          echo "Auth probe path: $API_URL/api/data/auth/me"

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Test 1: Gateway health endpoint
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      - name: '[1] Gateway health check'
        run: |
          echo "Testing $API_URL/health ..."
          RESPONSE=$(curl -sf --max-time 15 "$API_URL/health")
          echo "Response: $RESPONSE"
          echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -q '"status"' || (echo "FAIL: no status field in response" && exit 1)
          echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -q 'healthy'  || (echo "FAIL: status is not healthy" && exit 1)
          echo "PASS: gateway health OK"

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Test 2: CORS — preflight from the SWA frontend origin
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      - name: '[2] CORS preflight from frontend origin'
        run: |
          echo "Testing CORS preflight: $FRONTEND_URL → $API_URL/api/data/auth/login ..."
          HEADERS=$(curl -si --max-time 15 \
            -X OPTIONS \
            -H "Origin: $FRONTEND_URL" \
            -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST" \
            -H "Access-Control-Request-Headers: Content-Type,Authorization" \
            "$API_URL/api/data/auth/login")
          echo "$HEADERS"

          # The response must include Access-Control-Allow-Origin matching the frontend
          echo "$HEADERS" | grep -i "access-control-allow-origin" | grep -q "$FRONTEND_URL" \
            || (echo "FAIL: CORS header missing or wrong origin" && exit 1)

          # Must also allow credentials (needed for httpOnly refresh token cookie)
          echo "$HEADERS" | grep -i "access-control-allow-credentials" | grep -q "true" \
            || (echo "FAIL: Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true missing" && exit 1)

          echo "PASS: CORS preflight OK"

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Test 3: Frontend SWA is reachable and serves HTML
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      - name: '[3] Frontend reachability'
        run: |
          echo "Testing $FRONTEND_URL ..."
          BODY=$(curl -sf --max-time 15 -L "$FRONTEND_URL")
          echo "$BODY" | grep -q '<html' || (echo "FAIL: response does not look like HTML" && exit 1)
          echo "PASS: frontend is reachable"

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Test 4: Unauthenticated API request gets 401/403, not 404/502
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      - name: '[4] Auth guard returns 401 (not 502/404)'
        run: |
          echo "Testing unauthenticated GET $API_URL/api/data/auth/me ..."
          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -so /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 15 \
            -H "Origin: $FRONTEND_URL" \
            "$API_URL/api/data/auth/me")
          echo "HTTP status: $HTTP_CODE"
          [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "401" ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "403" ] \
            || (echo "FAIL: expected 401/403 but got $HTTP_CODE" && exit 1)
          echo "PASS: auth guard is active"

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Test 5: Gateway routing — /api/data/ reaches data-service
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      - name: '[5] Gateway routes /api/data/ to data-service'
        run: |
          echo "Testing $API_URL/api/data/health ..."
          RESPONSE=$(curl -sf --max-time 15 "$API_URL/api/data/health")
          echo "Response: $RESPONSE"
          echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -q 'data-service' \
            || (echo "FAIL: data-service not identified in health response" && exit 1)
          echo "PASS: /api/data/ routes correctly"

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Test 6: Gateway routing — /api/assets/ reaches ai-asset-service
      # The service exposes /health at container level only; through the
      # gateway we probe an authenticated endpoint and expect 401 (not 502).
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      - name: '[6] Gateway routes /api/assets/ to ai-asset-service'
        run: |
          echo "Testing $API_URL/api/assets/scans (unauthenticated → expect 401) ..."
          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -so /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 15 \
            "$API_URL/api/assets/scans")
          echo "HTTP status: $HTTP_CODE"
          [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "401" ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "403" ] \
            || (echo "FAIL: expected 401/403 but got $HTTP_CODE (502=gateway can't reach service)" && exit 1)
          echo "PASS: /api/assets/ routes correctly"

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Test 7: Gateway routing — /api/compliance/ reaches assessment-service
      # Same approach: probe an authenticated endpoint and expect 401 (not 502).
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      - name: '[7] Gateway routes /api/compliance/ to assessment-service'
        run: |
          echo "Testing $API_URL/api/compliance/assessments (unauthenticated → expect 401) ..."
          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -so /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 15 \
            "$API_URL/api/compliance/assessments")
          echo "HTTP status: $HTTP_CODE"
          [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "401" ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "403" ] \
            || (echo "FAIL: expected 401/403 but got $HTTP_CODE (502=gateway can't reach service)" && exit 1)
          echo "PASS: /api/compliance/ routes correctly"

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Test 8: Gateway routing — /api/behavior/ reaches behavior-service
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      - name: '[8] Gateway routes /api/behavior/ to behavior-service'
        run: |
          echo "Testing $API_URL/api/behavior/scenarios (unauthenticated → expect 401) ..."
          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -so /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 15 \
            "$API_URL/api/behavior/scenarios")
          echo "HTTP status: $HTTP_CODE"
          [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "401" ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "403" ] \
            || (echo "FAIL: expected 401/403 but got $HTTP_CODE (502=gateway can't reach service)" && exit 1)
          echo "PASS: /api/behavior/ routes correctly"

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Test 9: NGINX_FRONTEND_URL=off — non-API routes return 404, not 502
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      - name: '[9] Non-API gateway route returns 404 not 502'
        run: |
          echo "Testing that the gateway does not 502 on non-API paths ..."
          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -so /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 15 \
            "$API_URL/some-random-path-that-does-not-exist")
          echo "HTTP status: $HTTP_CODE"
          [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "404" ] \
            || (echo "FAIL: expected 404 but got $HTTP_CODE (502 = NGINX_FRONTEND_URL loopback bug)" && exit 1)
          echo "PASS: gateway returns 404 for non-API paths (NGINX_FRONTEND_URL=off is working)"

      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      # Summary
      # ----------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo ""
          echo "Smoke test results for: $ENV_NAME"
          echo "  API:      $API_URL"
          echo "  Frontend: $FRONTEND_URL"
